channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Otto Porter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Otto Porter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Otto Porter, Damion Lee
item.description:
“Otto Porter boxes out every single possession. Beli does a good job. Damion Lee. I just think we have a veteran group who understands if you plug all the leaks, you can keep that shell tight defensively and don’t worry about who is going to get the rebound. You can do it as a team, collectively.”

Steve Kerr on Otto Porter, Damion Lee, Nov 23, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Otto Porter
item.description:
KC Johnson:Jim Boylen on Otto Porter:

“His approach already is respected. His spirit is acknowledged. He’s got a brightness about him and a care factor.”

Jim Boylen on Otto Porter, Feb 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Otto Porter
item.description:
Mike McGraw:LaVine on Otto Porter:

“I know he's a really good 3 and D player, ... Another dude to come in here and try to help this thing get back to where it's supposed to be. We'll welcome him with open arms.”

Zach LaVine on Otto Porter, Feb 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @McGrawDHBulls.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on John Wall, Bradley Beal, Otto Porter
item.description:
After months of speculation surrounding the future of players like John Wall, Bradley Beal and Otto Porter Jr. amid the Wizards’ struggles, team owner Ted Leonsis went on the record to confirm his star players won’t be involved in trade talks ahead of the Feb. 7 trade deadline.

“Ilove when they go, ‘trade Bradley Beal. Trade John Wall. Trade Otto Porter.’ And I go ‘ok, for who?’ We’re not trading any of those players… wouldn’t throw in the towel on this core,”

Ted Leonsis on John Wall, Bradley Beal, Otto Porter, Feb 1, 2019. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Jeff Green on Otto Porter
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Jeff Green on Otto Porter saying Green will be dunking at 50:

“That's the plan. Dr. J is. Hopefully I am. I have a son and I will be dunking on him.”

Jeff Green on Otto Porter, Nov 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Kelly Oubre Jr. on Otto Porter
item.description:
Kelly Oubre Jr. on possibly stepping into starting lineup tonight in place of Otto Porter Jr.:

“Just got to take my energy drink a little earlier. Take my pregame caffeine pill and I’ll be good.”

Kelly Oubre Jr. on Otto Porter, Apr 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Otto Porter
item.description:
#Wizards coachScott Brooks on Otto Porter:

“Otto is developing into the deadly three-point shooter we know that he can be.”

Scott Brooks on Otto Porter, Jan 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Otto Porter
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Ted Leonsis on Otto Porter:

“He didn't take that next step ... I think this will be a breath of fresh air for him”

Ted Leonsis on Otto Porter, Apr 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @JMichaelCSN.

item.title: Randy Wittman on Otto Porter
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Randy Wittman on Otto Porter's injury:

“I don't know. If we had a game tonight he probably wouldn't play.”

Randy Wittman on Otto Porter, Jan 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Otto Porter
item.description:
Michael Lee:Leonsis on Otto Porter Jr.:

“To be blunt, whether Otto came from Georgetown or Syracuse, we would’ve drafted him. He was what we needed.”

Ted Leonsis on Otto Porter, Aug 2, 2013. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.
